apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 196 refreshes account sessions on foreground activation and every 15 seconds while browsing so Continue playing can discover a stream from another OpenNOW device. Failed listings retain known sessions. The iOS/iPadOS status bar stays hidden throughout streaming, even with controls visible, and returns on exit. Retains video/HUD preferences, reliable return handling, Metal 4, vibration, controller layouts and Sessions. 237 iPhone simulator tests passed, one hardware-only skip; four focused iPad tests passed. Physical cross-device handoff pending. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
